portrait_requirements.asset: One standalone vertical 9:16 photorealistic base portrait for a realistic talking-video avatar.
portrait_requirements.composition: Centered head and upper torso; full head visible with comfortable headroom; face about 45 percent of image width; eyes around 37 percent and chin around 58 percent of image height.
portrait_requirements.pose: Eye-level camera; direct gaze; head facing forward with a subtle four-degree downward pitch; chin gently forward and slightly down, never tucked into the throat; upright relaxed neck and level shoulders.
portrait_requirements.expression: Calm approachable neutral expression with lips softly closed, no visible teeth, and no broad smile.
portrait_requirements.jaw_safety: Both jaw sides visible, hair clear of the mouth and cheek edges, and one continuous natural jaw-to-neck contour without a hard horizontal chin crease, double outline, compressed neck, or artificial jaw sharpening.
portrait_requirements.rendering: Soft diffuse frontal light with gentle fill, realistic pores and natural skin texture, stable photographic depth of field, and no beauty-filter smoothing or airbrushing.
portrait_requirements.exclusions: One fictional adult only. No text, labels, captions, logos, watermarks, collage, hands near the face, eyewear, face-obscuring accessories, or readable background material.
